Global location strategy professional with more than 25 years of site selection, due diligence, and
negotiations expertise. In-market experience in more than 30 countries throughout North America, EMEA,
and APAC regions. Cross-functional capabilities, with a primary focus on siting data centers, manufacturing
plants, and other industrial scale operations. Led projects which have generated >$10B in capital investment,
